summary: Verified Status Embed Widget + Maintenance Auto-Silence end-to-end. Public badge SVG returns 200 with content-type image/svg+xml and correct aria-label (overall 'status: degraded', per-component 'email delivery: degraded', 'email delivery: maintenance' while a window is active). Admin embed panel opens via embed-toggle-btn, live preview loads (naturalWidth=110), HTML/Markdown snippets contain both /api/status/badge.svg and /status; embed-html-copy and embed-md-copy show success toasts ('HTML snippet copied' / 'Markdown snippet copied') and clipboard contents verified. Auto-silence re-confirmed via API: after resolving pre-existing email incident, creating an in-progress maintenance window for group 'email' blocked a new investigating incident from opening on POST /api/admin/deploy/diagnose (active_email=0), and after DELETE of the window a subsequent diagnose auto-opened a fresh incident (active_email=1, inc_c5ef3c8a9c). Public /status page still renders overall banner, uptime tabs (24h/7d/90d), Subscribe box, per-component rows and incident history; /status/email component page renders. All test-created maintenance windows and incidents were cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted transient maintenance windows (mnt_a225494dee, mnt_97a1bc74fb) and resolved transient auto-incidents (inc_73c935b6f2, inc_c5ef3c8a9c). No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Copy buttons use navigator.clipboard.writeText — in headless Playwright grant clipboard-read/clipboard-write via page.context.grant_permissions before asserting success toasts, otherwise you'll see 'Copy failed' which is a browser permission artifact, not a bug. Email delivery is legitimately 'degraded' in this env (no provider key) so overall badge=degraded is EXPECTED.
